notes.title: Release date set for Oct 7th!
notes.notes: All that hard work, and here we are.  The game is ready for release Oct 7th.  Thanks to everyone who has tested the game, given positive (or even critical) feedback, and those people who voted for Omega Reaction on Greenlight.  Oct 7th is just a couple weeks away!
